name: Threshtriumph
description: Swing both heads in a half circle ending one high and one low before the opponent.

name: Deluge Looping
description: Step to a corner of the basin stance so each head covers the angle the other cannot.

name: Prism Chainlink
description: Cross the hafts at the wrists to take a blow on both as a single brace.

name: Quenched Headball
description: Ring the two heads one after the other against a guard in a steady rhythm until it opens.

name: Stately Swivel
description: Meet a thrust with one head and answer with the other along the same line.

name: Thrallswivel
description: Hook one chain behind a weapon and draw it open for the second head to strike.

name: Steelflail
description: Bring both heads down in one stroke so their combined weight lands on a single point.

name: Sigil Linkband
description: Cross both chains round the opponent's weapon arm in loops and tighten to hold it still.

name: Illustrious Hingecap
description: Strike from opposite sides at once so the opponent is crushed between the two heads.

name: Peerless Inferno Rebound
description: Fall with left head then right in strict pairing so each blow lands as the guard answers the other until it breaks.

name: Squallwheel
description: Raise the head overhead on a rising step and hold it poised before the descent.

name: Deluge Swingthru
description: Glide backward on low steps with the head trailing like a hawk drawing off.

name: Swingarm Troth
description: Cross the arms before the face with the haft angled so a blow rolls off like air off a wing.

name: Thunderclap Wheel
description: Let the head fall steeply on a long chain so it strikes at the foot of the guard.

name: Reminiscence Spikehead
description: Lock attention on one gap in the guard and feel the chain tighten toward it.

name: Peal Thresh
description: Hook a spike under a sleeve or strap and snatch away the weapon hand.

name: Squall Flailhead
description: Lift the head under a low thrust so it climbs the blade and carries it away.

name: Haemal Lashout
description: Fall twice in a row onto the same guard before it can reset.

name: Commanding Chainring
description: Circle the head over the opponent in a tightening loop that wraps his arms and shoulders.

name: Haemalgimbal
description: Throw the head to the top of its arc then recall it down in a plunge faster than the throw.

name: Storied Quenched Thresh
description: Rise on the toes lift the head to its greatest height then plunge it as one blow carrying the whole body's weight.

name: Deft Rebound
description: Walk lightly on uneven wet ground with the head swinging clear of the stems underfoot.

name: Steel Wheel
description: Fall the head from the high side of a slope onto an opponent standing below.

name: Bedrock Chainlink
description: Hold the haft slanted like a sluice so a heavy blow runs down and off it.

name: Reminiscence Handstaff
description: Let the chain sway like reeds and read the opponent's reach by where it touches.

name: Thunderclap Headball
description: Whip the head round a guard on a bending path and land it on the trailing hand.

name: Triumphant Swivel
description: Swing low beneath a guard like water under a bank to hit the knee or ankle.

name: Consecrated Swingarm
description: Turn a blow aside along the current of the haft and let it slide out past the hip.

name: Unbending Flailhead
description: Drag the head across the ground to throw dust and gravel into the opponent's eyes.

name: Wheeltriumph
description: Gather swing upon swing until the whole mass of the head breaks on a guard like a spring flood.

name: Wrenching Swingthru
description: Weave the chain in crossing loops across the opponent's legs and arms like reeds netted together.

name: Quenched Lashout
description: Cleave the opponent's line of defense with a fall of the head that parts every guard like a river parting a bank.

name: Steel Spikehead
description: Bend and rebound the head through sway after sway until its returning stroke finds the guard the first swing loosened.

name: Haemalswivel
description: Start both heads orbiting in opposite directions on either side of the body.

name: Ethereal Linkband
description: Step in a slow circle against the heads' turning so body and iron move on opposing courses.

name: Stately Chainring
description: Keep both orbits closed around the body so no blow reaches it without crossing iron.

name: Inferno Hingecap
description: Release one orbiting head from its turn while the other keeps the guard.

name: Immaculate Swivel
description: Pass a blow from one orbit to the other so each sends it a little further away.

name: Sigilflail
description: Wind both chains in opposite directions round a weapon so it is locked by their opposed turns.

name: Solar Handstaff
description: Widen both orbits into overlapping rings that strike all comers on both sides.

name: Sigil Thresh
description: Catch a weapon in the crossing of the orbits and draw it into the chains.

name: Imperial Linkband
description: Close both orbits inward at once so the heads meet on a target at the centre.

name: Famed Lashout
description: Tighten the paired orbits turn by turn until every escape is closed and both heads fall on the guard together.

name: Handstaff Crown
description: Run both heads along separate tracks that cross at the opponent's centre.

name: Hingecap Voyage
description: Step on two alternating tracks so each foot answers one head's swing.

name: Magnanimous Chainring
description: Spread the qi field along both chains to feel every touch on either head.

name: Prismgimbal
description: Cross the hafts under a layer of qi so the guard holds against heavy iron.

name: Inferno Looping
description: Cross the tracks of the heads at the target so they strike an instant apart.

name: Pall Spikehead
description: Pass a parried blow through the qi field to the second head for the answer.

name: Gimbalvow
description: Pull both chains round a wrist from either side and haul the arm open.

name: Vigorswivel
description: Hand each swing from one head to the other so the cycle never rests.

name: Gallant Wheel
description: Spin the two heads in a repeating cycle until they sweep every side of the user.

name: Sigilwheel
description: Lock the opponent's weapon between the two tracks and hold it fast until the cycle ends.

name: Quenched Rebound
description: Bring both heads down along converging tracks so they land as a single crushing blow.

name: Magnificent Squall Swingarm
description: Run both heads through every track in turn so each blow feeds the next until the guard cannot recover.

name: Steel Looping
description: Fix the eye on the highest point of the arc and release the head as it peaks.

name: Bedrock Headball
description: Settle the weight on the formed Core so the stance holds through the heaviest recoil.

name: Squall Swingthru
description: Take a springing step that carries the body up with the swing.

name: Bedrock Spikehead
description: Feed the Core's qi down the chain at the moment the stoop begins.

name: Squallgimbal
description: Turn a descending blow along the line of the sky and let the head rise through it.

name: Swivelbenison
description: Spread the Core's qi upward and feel the height at which the head will turn.

name: Flailseal
description: Drop a chain loop from above over a shoulder and haul down.

name: Dauntless Linkband
description: Send fall after fall from the highest point of the orbit until the ground beneath is beaten flat.

name: Haemal Chainlink
description: Hold the head at the summit while the Core gathers then release the whole store into one descent.

name: Chainring Verdict
description: Throw the head beyond the reach of any guard and plunge it onto the target's crown from directly above.

name: Bedrock Looping
description: Gather the Core's qi through a long ascent of the head and let it fall from the summit as one overwhelming blow.

name: Bedrock Rebound
description: Draw the head from a low sworn stance and swing it up along the plateau's flat.

name: Swivel Seal
description: Face into the wind with the haft lowered and let the gust press the stance firm.

name: Deluge Headball
description: Run on the flat with the head trailing so the swing begins at the end of the run.

name: Swiveldecree
description: Swing across the wind so the head curves at the end of its arc into the flank.

name: Sacrosanct Hingecap
description: Hold the chain steady as a sworn line and turn the blow along it.

name: Sigil Flailhead
description: Cast a loop that the wind carries over the opponent's weapon arm then haul it tight.

name: Vigorthresh
description: Swing behind the body into the wind and let the gust bring the head round to an opponent at the back.

name: Vaunted Lashout
description: Let a gust lift the head and drop it from above the guard.

name: Solarswivel
description: Sweep the head in a great oath-circle that clears the ground around the user.

name: Haemal Swingthru
description: Swear the swing to the wind and drop the head in a gust to break through a set guard.

name: Splendid Vigor Swingarm
description: Roll the sworn swings one after another across the plateau so each gust carries the next blow beyond the guard's reach.

name: Quenched Chainlink
description: Throw the head into the wind and let the gust carry it the last pace to the target.

name: Consecrated Handstaff
description: Turn the haft into a gust so the wind helps push a blow aside.

name: Wraithlike Rebound
description: Drift a half step with the wind to leave the path of a swing.

name: Lordly Thresh
description: Time a hard swing to a tail gust so the head carries extra weight.

name: Gripping Thresh
description: Let a gust bend the chain round a weapon arm then close the loop.

name: Prismflail
description: Keep the head spinning in a gale so the wind itself forms part of the guard.

name: Tempestuous Flailhead
description: Spin the head into the wind and release a chain of blows each carried further by the gust.

name: Flaildecree
description: Fling the head the full length of the chain with the gale at its back to strike a far target.

name: Illustrious Wheel
description: Let the gale carry the head the final stretch so it lands at a speed no arm can give.

name: Paramount Thunderclap Linkband
description: Ride gust after gust with the head until a final one carries it to the guard with all the wind's weight.

name: Flailverdict
description: Pay out the long chain along a fixed bearing to reach a target at distance.

name: Deluge Hingecap
description: Step along a bearing so the foe's distance never changes.

name: Flailtroth
description: Hold the long chain taut across the body so blows meet iron links first.

name: Revelation Swingarm
description: Test the opponent's bearing by the tension and angle on the chain.

name: Lordly Headball
description: Cut the head back along the bearing it travelled to strike twice upon one line.

name: Haemal Spikehead
description: Whip the long chain back across the line of an attack to strike the striker.

name: Peal Swivel
description: Loop the chain over a blade along the bearing and turn it away.

name: Snaring Lashout
description: Tether a distant foe's arm by the chain and pull him along the bearing.

name: Flailedict
description: Sweep the long chain through its whole arc on a fixed bearing to strike all who stand in it.

name: Sigil Chainring
description: Pin the opponent's weapon along the chain's bearing and drag it out of line.

name: Vigor Looping
description: Hold the true bearing to the last instant and drop the head along it through a set guard.

name: Bedrock Flailhead
description: Keep the chain on one sworn bearing through every feint and let the head fall along that line when the guard opens.

name: Inferno Linkband
description: Swing the heavy chain through a squall so the head arrives with the wind's push.

name: Steelswivel
description: Plant the feet wide on loose ground so the chain's weight never pulls the stance.

name: Vigor Chainlink
description: Step off the line of a strike as a gust hits and let the gust cover the movement.

name: Clamping Wheel
description: Wrap the heavy chain once around a weapon arm and heave.

name: Sovereign Lashout
description: Roll the head through the gust in a ring that grows with each pass.

name: Delugeswivel
description: Hold the chain against a gust and bat a blow aside with its whole taut length.

name: Triumphant Wheel
description: Let the head hit a shield and rebound in the wind to the open side.

name: Vigor Rebound
description: Hammer fall after fall in the squall's rhythm until the guard sags under the weight.

name: Reaping Swingthru
description: Whirl the heavy chain into a hissing storm ring that strikes in every direction at once.

name: Vigorwheel
description: Wait for the squall's peak and release the stored weight of the chain in a single fall.

name: Handstaff Triumph
description: Take the squall's whole force into the chain and bring it down as one heavy stroke through guard and stance.

name: Squall Chainring
description: Start the whirl along the rim with an oath held to keep it steady however the wind turns.

name: Swivel Covenant
description: Take a sworn stance at the rim with the haft braced across the body.

name: Squall Spikehead
description: Step on the qi field's reading of the wind so each footfall lands as the gust passes.

name: Swiveltriumph
description: Strike at the cycle's turning point where the whirl's speed is greatest.

name: Parityswivel
description: Whirl a ring of iron at the rim that turns every rush aside.

name: Ruling Thresh
description: Hook the whirling chain over a weapon and wrench it out of line.

name: Entropy Swingarm
description: Spin the whirl wide under the open sky so blows rain on all sides.

name: Wrenching Headball
description: Lock the whirling chain round an opponent in a closing ring that cannot be broken from within.

name: Threshdecree
description: Complete the cycle on the rim and bring the head down in one fall that carries the whole turn's speed.

name: Wheelverdict
description: Keep the sworn whirl turning through every gust until the rim opens and the final fall breaks the guard.

name: Inferno Chainlink
description: Swing with the formed Core's qi sent down the chain in time with a gust.

name: Devout Hingecap
description: Root the stance on the Core and the bearing so the gale cannot turn the body.

name: Squall Handstaff
description: Step through a gust's leading edge with the head already swinging.

name: Flailbenison
description: Let the Core's qi feel the gale's turning and know where the next gust will come.

name: Haemal Looping
description: Feed the Core's qi into the whirling head so the gale itself adds to its speed.

name: Immaculate Flailhead
description: Counter a heavy blow with a chain held on a sworn line and turn it into the wind.

name: Gimbalpledge
description: Hook the chain round a weapon in a gust and wrench it away on the wind's pull.

name: Vigor Lashout
description: Sweep the head low under a guard with the wind behind it and take the legs.

name: Threshcrown
description: Sweep the head through the gale until blows strike every quarter of the field.

name: Bedrock Swingarm
description: Gather the Core's qi and the gale's push into the head and drop it as a crushing mass.

name: Paramount Thresh
description: Drop the head with the whole of the gale and the Core's qi behind it to break any set guard.

name: Imperial Vigor Headball
description: Gather the gale and the Core's qi through a long whirl and loose them as one fall that breaks guard stance and ground alike.
